d:
In an exclusive interview, The Hindu's Director, N. Ram, discusses Sonia Gandhi's memoir, recalling her initial reluctance to enter politics, the foreign-origin controversy and her decision to decline the Prime Minister's post in 2004 and nominate Manmohan Singh. He also recounts her conversation with former Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M. Karunanidhi and how the Congress-DMK alliance came together ahead of the 2004 Lok Sabha election.
Thank you for watching our video!
